nist.energy_cut_interpretation: CO+O dissociation cutoff, not total C+2O atomization D0
nist.natural_mixture: Abundance-weighted thermodynamic properties; no extra ideal-mixture entropy. Do not directly insert natural S into the NASA atomic convention.
nist.equation_5: Author PDF prints plus before squared mean. Independent published Q/H/S/Cp identities and equation18 support variance minus; table values are not modified.
nist.high_temperature_warning: Natural table warns no molecular dissociation above about3500K; distinguish frozen species from reacting mixture Cp, retaining bound-state/cutoff/continuum limits.
nist.uncertainty: Standard uncertainty propagated from effective-Hamiltonian parameter covariance; does not bound every systematic error.

UCL-4000.current_distributed_PF_interpretation: Numerically matches current states cut at26000cm-1; release intent/history unconfirmed. Full states match Table6 instead.

exomol.shared_inputs: Ames2 PES/TROVE for both; empirical CDSD/HITRAN data overlap NIST spectroscopic ancestry. New transition intensities are not new equilibrium validation.
exomol.626_symmetry: Allowed levels already enforce exchange symmetry; no second division by2.
exomol.626_zero: Lowest rovibrational state; no second ZPE correction.
